name: The Western Pylon
summary: A researcher asks you to search the crater’s western area for a crystal pylon. Finding the pylons may help their experiments.

sections.title: A Search in the Crater
sections.body: The researcher’s experiments have brought no positive results, so you are asked to look for a pylon in the crater’s western area. They wonder whether combining colors at the pylons could help, but first need you to find them.

faq.answer: You are searching for the Western Crystal Pylon in the crater’s western area.

faq.q: Why am I searching for a pylon?
faq.answer: The researcher hopes that combining colors at the pylons may help their experiments.
The Western Crystal Pylon is said to be somewhere in the crater’s western area.

faq.q: What does the researcher say about finding it?
faq.answer: The crater has hidden areas along its sides, and winding paths may lead somewhere worth exploring.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Western Pylon
